quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 release (details beyond the call): Asia-Pacific grew 8.5% organically and was 33.5% of net sales, Europe 30.6% and North America 25.5%. Semiconductor Solutions net sales were EUR 684 million (+17.3% organic) and Optronics EUR 187 million (-0.3% organic). FY2026 forecast by sector: Life Science net sales of about EUR 9,300 to 9,600 million, Healthcare about EUR 8,400 to 8,700 million and Electronics about EUR 3,300 to 3,500 million; group free cash flow of about EUR 1,800 to 2,300 million. The guidance assumes no US Mavenclad sales from August 2026 (previous forecast: from May 2026) and excludes potential US commercialization of Pergoveris.

quarterly_data.signal: Healthcare Q2 2026 (company release): Rare Diseases net sales EUR 115 million (Ogsiveo EUR 75 million, Gomekli EUR 39 million); Pimicotinib sales in the low single-digit million-euro range after China approved it for tenosynovial giant cell tumor in December 2025; Erbitux EUR 303 million (+4.9% organic), Mavenclad EUR 275 million (-10.2%), Bavencio EUR 130 million (-16.8%) and Gonal-f EUR 179 million (-2.7%). In June 2026 Merck KGaA announced a strategic research-stage collaboration with Saturnus Bio aimed at a foundational portfolio in rare genetic cardiomyopathies.
